description: This file defines a custom Blazor input component (CustomInputSelect<TValue>) that extends InputSelect to support integer parsing, providing a workaround for Blazor's native support limitations before .NET 5.0.

classes.name: CustomInputSelect<TValue>
classes.description: A custom Blazor component that extends InputSelect to add integer parsing capability.

methods.name: TryParseValueFromString
methods.description: Overrides the default method to parse string values into TValue, specifically handling conversion to int before falling back to the base implementation.
